chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, from Matar ibn Arqam who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar the governor sent for me, so I went to him, and in front of him were two men. One of them had grabbed his companion and scratched his face. He (the governor) said, 'What do you say, O Abu Abdullah, regarding these two men?' I said, 'And what did they both say?' He said, 'One of them said, 'There is no merit for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) over anyone from the Banu Umayya in terms of nobility,' and the other said to him, 'He has the merit over all people at all times.' And the one who supported the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) got angry, so he did with his face what you see. So is there anything upon him?'

So I said to him, 'I think you have already asked those around you, so they informed you.' He said, 'I swear to you, I have not said it.' So I said, 'It would be fitting for the one who claimed that anyone is equal to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in merit, that he should be killed and not be left to live.' He said, 'Or is not the nobility (of descent) one?' I said, 'Indeed, nobility is not lineage. Do you not see, if I were to lodge a man from some of these races (the poor/commoners), and I said, 'This is the nobility,' would that be acceptable?' He said, 'Or is not the lineage one?' I said, 'When they are gathered to Adam (peace be upon him), then the lineage is one. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not mix with polytheism, nor with unchasteness/arrogance.' So the governor ordered it, and he was killed.'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between lineage (nasab) and nobility (hasab) in Shia theology according to the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Shia distinction between mere biological lineage (nasab) and spiritual merit (fadl), asserting that the Prophet’s superiority stems from his purity from polytheism and arrogance rather than just ancestry. The Imam’s verdict to execute the Umayyad claimant underscores the principle that claiming equality with the Prophet in all respects, including his unique spiritual status, warrants capital punishment. This narrative reinforces the theological basis for the Ahl al-Bayt’s exclusive merit, contrasting it with the Umayyad reliance on tribal genealogy.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Matar Bin Arqam who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying that Abul Aziz Bin Umar the governor sent an escort to me, so I<sup>asws</sup> went over to him, and in front of him were two men, one of them had grabbed his companions, so he scratched his face, and he (the governor) said, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying, O Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding these two men?’ I<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘And what did they both say?’ He said, ‘One of them said, ‘There is not merit for Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> over anyone from the Clan of Umayya with regards to the nobility’, and the other one said to him, ‘He<sup>saww</sup> has the merit over the people, all of them, regarding every thing’, and the one who supported Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> got angered, so he did with his face what you<sup>asws</sup> see. So is there anything upon him?’

So I<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> think you have already asked the ones around you, so they have informed you’. So he said, ‘I swear to you<sup>asws</sup>, I have not said it’. So I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It would be befitting for the one who alleges that anyone is similar to Rasool-Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with regards to the merits, that he should be killed, and not be left to live’. So he said, ‘Or is not the nobility of descent, one?’ So I<sup>asws</sup> said:’ The nobility is not the lineage. Do you not see, if I<sup>asws</sup> were to lodge a man from some of these races, your poor ones, so I said, ‘This is the nobility (that would be allowed)’. So he said, ‘Is not the lineage, one?’ I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it is gathered to Adam<sup>as</sup>, so the lineage is one, (except that) Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> did not mix with Polytheism, nor unchasteness’. So the governor ordered it, so he was killed’.
